definition: Heavy and Light are processed independently. No downstream H/L interaction before final prediction merge.
H residues, L residues, REG_H and REG_L participate in unrestricted joint Transformer communication.
H/L biological residues communicate jointly, while REG_H and REG_L retain chain-specific roles.
H and L are first encoded separately. Then REG_H reads Light residues and REG_L reads Heavy residues. Biological residues themselves do not directly cross-attend in this stage.
H and L are first encoded separately. Then REG_H and REG_L interact through the frozen canonical D3 fusion module.
